QuestInfo.name: Making a Saddle
QuestInfo.0: Ask #b#p2060005##k in #b#m230000000##k to make you a saddle.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2060005#, after measuring #p1013000#, declares that a Dragon Saddle must be custom made to fit #p1013000#. He'll make one for you for a fee of 100,000 mesos if you supply the materials.

You can obtain the materials by entering the door of the Mushroom House between the Ribbon Pigs upstairs.
QuestInfo.2: You received a completed saddle from #p2060005#.

0.0: Hmm... That is a really strange-looking lizard. It almost looks like a Dragon. Of course I doubt anyone would ride a Dragon! You have a really peculiar mount.
0.1: I've only seen people riding birds, pigs, wolves, etc. so I know the saddle sizes of those animals, but I can't even begin to guess at the size of this strange animal. Let me take some measurements.
0.2: #b(#p2060005# takes measurements of #p1013000#'s waist, wing span, head size, tail circumference, and more. But why is he measuring the length of his nails? And why is he making him open his mouth?)#k
0.3: Hmm. The size of this animal is so different! You're going to have to #bspecial order a saddle#k. Is that okay with you?

1.0: Oh, you've gathered all of the materials needed for the saddle. Will you give them to me along with the fee? I will make your saddle right away!

yes.0: Here, the completed saddle! In order to protect your bottom from that animal's hard scales, I covered the thick body of the saddle with pearl dust. Doesn't it look beautiful?
yes.1: Enjoy your saddle and feel free to come back if you lose it. Since I made it once, I should be able to make it again pretty easily.

item.0:
You still haven't gotten it together? 

I'll make your saddle if you bring me #b50 pieces of #t4000592##k, #b1 #t4032474##k, and a #bspeeecial customer fee of 100,000 mesos#k!

You can get the materials by going up a floor and entering the Orange Mushroom house between the Pig Ribbons.
